```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
from html import escape
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit
from IPython.display import HTML, display

with open("content/applications.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

hero = data.get("hero", {})
section = data.get("section", {})
projects = data.get("projects", [])


def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)


def site_url(value):
    """Convert local Quarto page links to published HTML links."""
    url = str(value or "").strip()
    if not url:
        return ""

    parts = urlsplit(url)

    if not parts.scheme and not parts.netloc:
        path = parts.path
        if path.endswith(".qmd"):
            path = path[:-4] + ".html"

        return urlunsplit((
            parts.scheme,
            parts.netloc,
            path,
            parts.query,
            parts.fragment
        ))

    return url


def primary_link(project):
    internal = str(project.get("project_href") or "").strip()
    external = str(project.get("homepage_url") or "").strip()

    if internal:
        return site_url(internal), "View Project", False

    if external:
        return external, "Visit Project Website", True

    return "", "", False


cards = []
dialogs = []

for i, project in enumerate(projects):

    project_id = f"cw-project-dialog-{i}"

    name = safe(project.get("project_name"))
    category = safe(project.get("category_title"))
    image = safe(site_url(project.get("image")))
    alt = safe(project.get("alt") or project.get("project_name"))
    caption = safe(project.get("caption"))
    description = safe(project.get("description"))
    partners = safe(project.get("partners"))
    funding = safe(project.get("funding"))

    href, button_label, external = primary_link(project)

    link_html = ""

    if href:
        target = (
            ' target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"'
            if external else ""
        )

        link_html = f"""
        <a class="cw-project-primary-link"
           href="{safe(href)}"{target}>
          {safe(button_label)}
          <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
        </a>
        """

    cards.append(f"""
    <button
      type="button"
      class="cw-project-card"
      data-dialog="{project_id}"
      aria-haspopup="dialog"
      aria-label="Learn more about {name}">

      <div class="cw-project-card-image">
        <img src="{image}" alt="{alt}" loading="lazy">
      </div>

      <div class="cw-project-card-content">
        <span class="cw-project-category">{category}</span>
        <h3>{name}</h3>

        <span class="cw-project-card-action">
          Explore project
          <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
        </span>
      </div>
    </button>
    """)

    dialogs.append(f"""
    <dialog class="cw-project-dialog"
            id="{project_id}"
            aria-labelledby="{project_id}-title">

      <div class="cw-project-dialog-header">
        <div>
          <span class="cw-project-dialog-category">{category}</span>
          <h2 id="{project_id}-title">{name}</h2>
        </div>

        <button type="button"
                class="cw-project-close"
                aria-label="Close project details">
          &times;
        </button>
      </div>

      <div class="cw-project-dialog-body">

        <div class="cw-project-dialog-media">
          <img src="{image}" alt="{alt}">
          <p class="cw-project-caption">{caption}</p>
        </div>

        <div class="cw-project-dialog-details">

          <section>
            <h3>Description</h3>
            <p>{description}</p>
          </section>

          <section>
            <h3>Partners</h3>
            <p>{partners}</p>
          </section>

          <section>
            <h3>Funding</h3>
            <p>{funding}</p>
          </section>

          {link_html}

        </div>
      </div>

    </dialog>
    """)


html = f"""
<div class="cw-applications">

  <section class="cw-applications-hero">
    <div class="cw-applications-hero-content">

      <span class="cw-applications-eyebrow">
        {safe(hero.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h1>{safe(hero.get("title"))}</h1>

      <p>{safe(hero.get("description"))}</p>

    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="cw-applications-directory">

    <div class="cw-applications-heading">

      <span class="cw-applications-section-label">
        {safe(section.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(section.get("title"))}</h2>

      <p>{safe(section.get("description"))}</p>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-project-grid">
      {''.join(cards)}
    </div>

  </section>

  {''.join(dialogs)}

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

  const cards = document.querySelectorAll(".cw-project-card");
  const dialogs = document.querySelectorAll(".cw-project-dialog");

  cards.forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener("click", () => {

      const id = card.dataset.dialog;
      const dialog = document.getElementById(id);

      if (dialog) {
        dialog.showModal();
      }

    });
  });

  dialogs.forEach(dialog => {

    const closeButton = dialog.querySelector(".cw-project-close");

    closeButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
      dialog.close();
    });

    dialog.addEventListener("click", event => {
      if (event.target === dialog) {
        dialog.close();
      }
    });

  });

});
</script>
